name: Red Robin
notes: 3 photos, two different printed menus. Photos 2-3 are two pages of the same current fold-out menu (Bacon Bash/burgers/apps, then sandwiches/entrees/salads/sides/desserts) and are the main source. Photo 1 is a separate, older-design 'Craft Burgers' page sharing several items (Madlove, Royal Red Robin, Whiskey River BBQ, Banzai, Bacon Cheeseburger, Gourmet Cheeseburger, Sauteed 'Shroom, Keep It Simple, Veggie, Impossible Burger) at different prices; those were treated as the same dishes already captured from photos 2-3 and not duplicated. Items unique to photo 1 (Bacon 'N' Bleu, Cheesy Bacon Fondue, Jalapeno Heatwave, A.1. Steakhouse, Monster Double, Smashed Avocado 'N' Bacon, Turkey Burger) were added. Feelin' Saucy sauce list and calorie counts were skipped as non-dish info.
